label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: y el aroma y el aceite a la lumbrera y a aceite de la unción y a incienso de los aromas.
spanish: y el aroma y el aceite a lumbrera y a aceite de la unción y a incienso de los aromas.

units.es: y a aceite de la unción
y a incienso de los aromas

grammarChanges: Removed the definite article from "la lumbrera" (h02035028005, לְמָאוֹר is Ncmsa absolute with no Hebrew article, unlike the definite nouns beside it), giving "a lumbrera".
readerNote: Left "aroma"/"aromas" (h02035028002, h02035028009) unchanged because narrowing H1314/H5561 to spice versus balsam would resolve a meaning ambiguity outside this grammar pass; only the article on "lumbrera" was corrected to match the unarticulated Hebrew noun.
